data.content:
Argentina is currently operating without Messi’s successor as captain, Cristian Romero, due to injury, so Roma’s Leonardo Balerdi and Manchester United’s Lisandro Martínez started at center back against Uruguay. Scaloni doesn’t have an array of options at the position this month, so the same pair could start again on Tuesday.

Argentina predicted lineup vs. Costa Rica (4-3-3): Musso; Giay, Balerdi, Martínez, Tagliafico; Barco, Paz, Eq. Fernández; Prestianni, Castro, Simeone. [...] Striker Manfred Ugalde has returned to the fold this month after serving a suspension, but new manager Ruiz won’t have Alexis Gamboa at his disposal after he was stretchered off in Quito. The defender has returned to Costa Rica to undergo more tests and determine the severity of his knee injury.

Kendall Waston had been approached to provide cover for Gamboa’s injury, but the 38-year-old isn’t expected to travel to Argentina. [...] ### Prediction: Argentina 2–0 Costa Rica
